meta.title: Privacy · Banaro
meta.description: What Banaro collects, why, how long we keep it and what we never do.

title: Your privacy
sub: What we collect, why, and what we never do.
intro: We keep this simple because we think you should be able to read it in five minutes. Banaro follows Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).

collect.title: What we collect
collect.given: What you give us: your name, e-mail, neighbourhood, role, skills, projects and any messages you send through Banaro.
collect.technical: A little technical information, such as your browser type, so the site works properly and stays secure.

use.title: What we do with it
use.text: We use your details to show your profile to other members, suggest people nearby, run events and send e-mail. We e-mail you only for what you ask for: your account, your messages, your event RSVPs and a Monday digest if you turn it on. You can turn any of these off in your settings.

never.title: What we never do
never.sell: We do not sell your data, and we do not share it with advertisers.
never.address: We do not show your street address. Other members see your neighbourhood only.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.account: Your profile, projects, messages and preferences stay while your account is open.
retention.deletion: When you delete your account, we erase your personal information within 30 days.
retention.sessions: Sign-in sessions end after 30 days without activity, and after 90 days at the most.
retention.logs: Technical logs, which never hold your e-mail or messages, are kept for 30 days.

processors.title: Who helps us run Banaro
processors.text: A few service providers process data for us under contract and only on our instructions:
processors.hosting: Our hosting provider, which runs our servers and stores our data.
processors.email: Our e-mail delivery provider, which sends account, message and event e-mail.
processors.scanning: Our file-scanning service, which checks uploaded photos for malware.

location.title: Where it lives
location.text: Your data is stored in Canada.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We use essential cookies only: one to keep you signed in and one to remember your light or dark theme. There are no tracking or advertising cookies.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.access: You can see the personal information we hold about you.
rights.export: You can download a copy of your data from your settings.
rights.correct: You can correct your profile and account details at any time.
rights.delete: You can delete your account from your settings.

contact.title: Contact our privacy lead
